tools.name: simulation.inject_failure
tools.title: Inject Failure
tools.description: Requires simulationId and resourceId from simulation.create. Injects a bounded resource failure; returns updated state. Next tool is simulation.step, then simulation.recover_resource and simulation.metrics to confirm authoritative health. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/simulation.inject_failure

type.description: Only cdn_cache_loss or az_outage, with an explicit CDN-capable network resourceId or resourceName; no random/node-pool selectors. Cache loss forwards misses; az_outage blocks the edge. Omit type and duration for legacy quick failures.

duration.description: Only with explicit type cdn_cache_loss or az_outage and CDN-capable network resourceId or resourceName. Integer 1–86400 simulation steps, not seconds; default 30. No random/node-pool selectors; omit for legacy quick failures.

tools.name: simulation.recover_resource
tools.title: Recover Failed Resource
tools.description: Requires simulationId and resourceId from simulation.create. Requests reversible resource recovery; success does not prove healthy. Next tool is simulation.step, then simulation.metrics to inspect resource health. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/simulation.recover_resource

tools.name: simulation.delete
tools.title: Delete Simulation
tools.description: The likely next tool is simulation.create to use the freed slot. Prerequisite: a simulationId from simulation.create, or an active simulation in the preserved MCP session. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/simulation.delete

tools.name: scenario.list
tools.title: List Scenarios
tools.description: No prerequisites. Returns paginated scenarios cards with scenarioId (alias of id), name, summary and available provider/category/difficulty. Pass scenarioId to scenario.get. Filters precede stable ID paging: limit default 8, maximum 20; pass nextCursor as cursor until null. detailed=true restores rich cards. Next tool is scenario.get, then simulation.create with scenarioId. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/scenario.list

tools.name: scenario.get
tools.title: Get Scenario
tools.description: Requires scenarioId returned by scenario.list (also available as id). Returns the complete selected graph, presets, assumptions and phase details. Next tool is simulation.create with scenarioId or the hydrated resources/connections. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/scenario.get

tools.name: simulation.create
tools.title: Create Simulation
tools.description: Create from scenarioId (scenario.list → scenario.get), or resources/connections for a custom graph. Returns id for simulation.step. Never blindly retry a timeout: creation may have succeeded. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/simulation.create GCP gcpFitPrediction: holdout-validated for one us-central1 topology at 300–500 RPS; see guide.

databaseConnectionModel.description: Physical database opt-in: held-pools uses current running host replicas for named/legacy pools; static binding preserves independent consumers. Explicit managedPoolId deduplicates backend pools; dedicated proxy server slots never multiply by tasks. Inspect runtimeConnections, pools and connectionLimitProvenance.

maxConnections.description: Fixed concurrent DB connection budget; Aurora Serverless defaults from maximum configured ACU.

appDbPoolSize.description: Owned typical: pool size 250 on each app.

databaseConsumers.description: Named logical pools, not billed resources. On the target database select held-pools to assume full pools retained by current running host replicas. Static binding preserves independent replicas. Explicit managedPoolId/mode shares backend slots once; proxy is dedicated. Full constraints and transaction client/server limits: linked tool guide. Results: metrics.databases[].runtimeConnections, pools, firstSaturation and connectionLimitProvenance; ASSUMED/MODELED, not measured sessions.

gpuReadiness.description: EKS assumptions, not measured performance. initialReadyNodes required; warmSpareNodes adds ready reserve. autoscalerReaction/nodeProvision/imagePull/modelLoad: {seconds,provenance}. capacity: {unit:'requests-per-second'|'concurrent-calls',perNode,provenance}; concurrent-calls needs meanCallDurationSeconds. servedRequestP99Ms: {value,provenance}. provenance: user-supplied|estimated. Missing phases/capacity stay not_evaluated; omit for legacy behavior. Full constraints: linked guide.

nodePools.description: EKS GPU pools: id/name, size, nodeCount/minNodes/maxNodes; each has gpuReadiness as above.

autoscalingConfig.description: Complete autoscaling policy, including min/max bounds, thresholds and cooldowns. Preserved without duplicate top-level bounds; explicit top-level bounds and CPU targets take precedence. Unknown fields are rejected. Pass scenario.get's config when copying its graph.

ecsCpuTargetTracking.description: Opt into CPU-only ECS Fargate target tracking; requires an AWS Fargate compute resource. Required for scaleOutCooldownSeconds, scaleInCooldownSeconds and top-level simulationSecondsPerStep; other providers keep their existing policy.

scaleOutCooldownSeconds.description: ECS scale-out cooldown in simulated seconds; requires ecsCpuTargetTracking: true with an AWS Fargate compute resource. Defaults to cooldownSeconds.

scaleInCooldownSeconds.description: ECS scale-in cooldown in simulated seconds; requires ecsCpuTargetTracking: true with an AWS Fargate compute resource. Defaults to cooldownSeconds.

simulationSecondsPerStep.description: Requires ecsCpuTargetTracking: true with an AWS Fargate compute resource. Converts ECS cooldown seconds into step counts only (default 1); not a global simulation clock.

tools.name: simulation.step
tools.title: Simulate Step
tools.description: Requires simulationId from simulation.create (optional in demo). Returns completedSteps/currentStep; next tool is simulation.metrics. Retry same operationId/inputs. CWM_RAMP_GAP_NOT_ERRORS="true": owned AWS lean/2-app typical-v1 (500-RPS diagnostic) returns rampAveragingShortfallPct=100*(1-throughput/offeredRps), not errors; goodputSemantics=whole_run_average_including_warmup_ramp. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/simulation.step calibrationEligibility: recorded AWS selection, reasons and warnings; not measurement validation. Owned AWS calibrated outputs may include rampAveragingShortfallPct: the warmup-ramp goodput gap, reported separately and not counted as errors.

operationId.description: Optional retry ID: omit for a new ID; reuse with identical inputs replays the saved result, while changed inputs, expired results or another run return 409.

expectedCheckpoint.description: Optional guard for new steps: omit to skip; a mismatched generation, currentStep or supplied metricId rejects the step with 409 without advancing.

tools.name: simulation.metrics
tools.title: Get Simulation Metrics
tools.description: Requires simulationId from simulation.create (demo optional). Returns latest/history; full=evidence. CWM_RAMP_GAP_NOT_ERRORS="true": owned AWS lean/2-app typical-v1 (500-RPS diagnostic) returns rampAveragingShortfallPct=100*(1-throughput/offeredRps), not errors; goodputSemantics=whole_run_average_including_warmup_ramp. No API key required; demo limits apply. cwm://guides/public/simulation.metrics calibrationEligibility: recorded AWS selection, reasons and warnings; not measurement validation. GCP gcpFitPrediction: holdout-validated for one us-central1 topology at 300–500 RPS; see guide. Owned AWS calibrated outputs may include rampAveragingShortfallPct: the warmup-ramp goodput gap, reported separately and not counted as errors.

tools.name: simulation.inject_traffic
tools.title: Inject Traffic
tools.description: Requires simulationId from simulation.create and target traffic RPS. Returns applied traffic settings. Next tool is simulation.step, then simulation.metrics to read observed latency; do not assume its direction. No API key required; demo limits apply. Read resource cwm://guides/public/simulation.inject_traffic
